meta.note: Status of each standard must be verified against the issuing body (ISO, ISO/SAE, UNECE) before it is presented as current. Edition numbers and publication years below reflect the commonly published versions; audit before reliance.

standards.title: ISO 26262 (Road vehicles — Functional safety)
standards.scope: Safety lifecycle for E/E systems in road vehicles; ASIL allocation.
standards.saRelevance: Component-level safety case foundation for any local vehicle/ADS project.

standards.title: ISO/PAS 21448 SOTIF (Safety Of The Intended Functionality)
standards.scope: Residual risk from intended functionality incl. perception limitations.
standards.saRelevance: Critical for perception validation on SA roads; evolving into full ISO 21448.

standards.title: ISO/SAE 21434 (Cyber security engineering)
standards.scope: Cybersecurity risk management across vehicle lifecycle.
standards.saRelevance: Basis for the cyber risk score; fleet security architecture.

standards.title: ISO 24089 (Road vehicles — Software update engineering)
standards.saRelevance: OTA safety and governance for fleets.

standards.title: ISO 34501 (Terms and definitions for testing of automated driving systems)
standards.saRelevance: Common language for the scenario library.

standards.title: ISO 34502 (Scenario-based safety evaluation framework)
standards.saRelevance: Backbone for SA scenario library methodology.

standards.title: ISO 34503 (ODD taxonomy for ADS)
standards.scope: Standardised taxonomy for Operational Design Domain.
standards.saRelevance: ODD description standard for all corridor/mine pilot plans here.

standards.title: UN Reg. No. 155 (Cyber security and cyber security management systems)
standards.saRelevance: Whether SA homologation references R155 depends on national regulation; verify.

standards.title: UN Reg. No. 156 (Software update and software update management system)
UN Reg. No. 157 (Automated Lane Keeping Systems — ALKS)
standards.scope: First binding ADS regulation; L3 ALKS up to defined speeds on motorways.
standards.saRelevance: Template for any SA L3 highway regime; assess whether SA is an EU/ECE operating market for type approval.

notes: South Africa's status under WP.29 (whether and how UN vehicle regulations apply to locally registered vehicles) must be verified; RSA vehicle approval historically references SABS/e-Mark practices without full WP.29 membership.
For any maintained system, version each standard with edition + year + verification date; a document from 2018 must never be presented as 'current' without audit.
The SA-specific reference: SANS standards and NRTA schedules amend vehicle requirements independently; keep the standards layer distinct from the legal layer.
